name: Chemical → Article → Trial → Sponsor
cypher: MATCH (c:Chemical)<-[:MENTIONS_CHEMICAL]-(a:Article)-[:REFERENCED_IN]->(t:ClinicalTrial)-[:SPONSORED_BY]->(sp:Sponsor) WHERE c.name = 'Paclitaxel' RETURN sp.name, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: MeSH → Article → Trial → Outcome
cypher: MATCH (m:MeSHTerm)<-[:ANNOTATED_WITH]-(a:Article)-[:REFERENCED_IN]->(t:ClinicalTrial)-[:MEASURES]->(o:Outcome) WHERE m.name = 'Breast Neoplasms' RETURN o.measure, count(DISTINCT t) AS trials ORDER BY trials DESC LIMIT 10

name: 6KG: poverty → disease burden correlation
cypher: MATCH (c1:Country)-[:HAS_INDICATOR]->(pov:SocioeconomicIndicator) WHERE pov.indicator_code = 'SI.POV.DDAY' AND pov.value > 30 AND pov.year = 2019 WITH c1.iso_code AS iso, c1.name AS name, pov.value AS poverty ORDER BY poverty DESC LIMIT 5 MATCH (c2:Country)-[:REPORTED]->(dr:DiseaseReport) WHERE c2.iso_code = iso AND dr.year = 2023 RETURN name, poverty, count(dr) AS disease_reports ORDER BY poverty DESC
